name: noreturn-callee-save
conditions: RaiseException-like noreturn import; matching MSVC build

name: typed-member-return
conditions: callee returns owning object and target carries EAX into a later receiver

name: volatile-zero-store
conditions: target has a selective zero store; use only with source store evidence

name: allocation-result-flow
conditions: allocation result copied only on nonzero path, returned afterward

name: branch-layout
conditions: same semantics, inverted or shared fall-through shape

name: argument-order
conditions: decoded immediate pushes prove a two-argument reversal

name: stack-layout
conditions: one decoded stack offset differs and source has one matching padding array

name: indirect-thiscall-pointer
conditions: target has mov ecx,receiver before indirect call; candidate pushes placeholder first arg; source has __stdcall function pointer; try diagnosed call-argument reversal

name: direct-member-receiver
conditions: target loads ECX before direct callee; source passes this as explicit void* first argument; one unambiguous struct

name: static-receiver-thiscall-pointer
conditions: target loads static receiver into ECX and calls indirect pointer; source has two-argument stdcall declaration; may require argument swap and propagated bool return

name: indirect-bool-return
conditions: candidate adds mov al,1 after indirect call; bool function discards callee result

name: return-carrier-thiscall
conditions: target pushes EAX from prior call, loads indirect receiver in ECX, and calls; candidate discards producer result

name: rtti-operator-indirect
conditions: source uses one RTTI operator== expression; target has an indirect call with static receiver

name: virtual-call-view
conditions: plain two-int vtable-backed storage; target EDX positive and ECX negative delta; raw indirect release call

name: virtual-slot-view
conditions: raw __thiscall vtable expression; target has one pushed argument and candidate moves it to ECX; bounded slot offset

name: direct-member-noarg
conditions: target loads ECX before direct no-argument helper; source declares extern __stdcall helper called from one struct member
